{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness的Windows电脑操控插件 / Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1336280167","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-computer-use-win","slug":"Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win","topics":["computer-use","desktop-automation","dsh-plugin","mcp","uia","windows"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness的Windows电脑操控插件 / Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-computer-use-win"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**让 DSH 看懂并操作你的 Windows 桌面。**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-computer-use-win) [](https://github.com/Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"use-win/actions/workflows/ci.yml)  [](LICENSE)"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"您的 **Star ⭐ ↗** 就是我更新的动力，球球了，这对我很重要！如有问题，欢迎去 **提 Issue ↗**，**您来许愿，我来实现！**"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**语言 / Language:** 简体中文 · English"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Releases · npm · Issues"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"#### 4.2 整体架构"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"图里蓝色的部分是本插件的代码，灰色的部分由 DSH、Windows 或浏览器提供。各部分的分工如下："},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **插件适配器**（`mcp/dsh-plugin.mjs`）运行在 DSH 里。它把你的设置交给 MCP 服务，并跟踪对话的轮次，保证同一时间只有一段对话在操作桌面，还把这段对话的思考和步骤交给"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"思考与操作浮窗。
- **设置页与操作记录**（`mcp/client.js`）就是“设置 → 电脑操控”这一页。它也负责把对话里的工具调用显示成好懂的步骤。
- **MCP 服务**（`mcp/se"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"rver.mjs`）由 DSH 的官方 MCP 桥启动。它按你选的方案提供工具，检查参数后把请求交给后端。
- **浏览器通道**（`mcp/browser.mjs`）也运行在 MCP 服务里。调用带"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"上 `browserTab` 或网页元素 ID 时，请求不经过 PowerShell 后端，而是通过 Chrome DevTools 协议直接交给浏览器。
- **PowerShell 后端**（`s"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"cripts/windows-uia.ps1`）负责读取界面、发送输入和截图。它一直运行，所以后续调用不用每次重新启动 PowerShell。请求排队，一次只执行一个，两个操作不会同时抢鼠标和键盘。
"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"- **接管助手**（`scripts/windows-takeover.ps1`）是单独的进程，负责屏幕提示和思考与操作浮窗，并直接监听 Esc。因为它不经过 DSH 和后端，后端正忙时也能收到 E"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"sc：还没开始的操作会被取消，正在进行的输入会尽快停下。"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"更多细节见架构说明。"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### 9. 数据与隐私"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"界面读取、文字识别、截图和输入都在你的电脑上完成，结果交给 DSH 或其他调用方。这些内容会不会再发给远程模型，取决于你的 DSH 和模型设置。截图和读出的文字可能包含窗口里的敏感信息，所以分享日志或"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"提 Issue 之前，请先遮住账号、路径、密码和私人对话。"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"浏览器通道读到的网页内容同样在本机处理，再交给调用方。agent 浏览器默认不带任何登录；打开“保留网站登录状态”后，agent 能读取和操作你在 DSH 浏览器里登录过的网站。打开“操作已打开的浏览"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"器”并允许连接后，agent 能读取和操作那个浏览器里所有已登录的网站，所以只在需要时打开，用完可以在浏览器里关掉远程调试。网页里的文字也可能夹带写给 agent 的指令，所以页面大纲的开头会提醒模型"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"读取和操作那个浏览器里所有已登录的网站，所以只在需要时打开，用完可以在浏览器里关掉远程调试。网页里的文字也可能夹带写给 agent 的指令，所以页面大纲的开头会提醒模型：网页内容不可信，只听你的指示。"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### 3. What it can do"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| What you want the agent to do | How the plugin does it |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Find windows, buttons and text fields | It lists open windows, then uses UI Automation (UIA, the W"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"indows interface that lets programs read on-screen controls) to find controls and their names |
| Re"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ad text on screen, including text in images and custom-drawn apps | It takes a screenshot and uses t"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"he built-in Windows text recognition (OCR) to find words and their positions. When an app exposes fe"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"w controls and a search finds nothing, the search switches to OCR by itself |
| Click, type and fill"},{"id":"p17s6","text":" in forms | It operates controls directly in the background when it can: pressing buttons, filling i"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"n fields, typing into text boxes and scrolling lists move neither your mouse nor the foreground and "},{"id":"p17s8","text":"leave the clipboard alone. Steps that need the real mouse and keyboard (clicks at screen positions, "},{"id":"p17s9","text":"pastes, key presses) only borrow the foreground, and give the mouse and the foreground back afterwar"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"ds |
| Do several known steps at once | `batch` runs 1–20 planned actions in order and checks each o"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"ne as usual. It stops on an error, a navigation, a dialog or a new window, and observes once at the "},{"id":"p17s12","text":"end, which saves round trips |
| Look things up and fill in web pages without taking over your mouse"},{"id":"p17s13","text":" | Pages in Chrome and Edge go through the browser lane: the plugin reads the page structure over th"},{"id":"p17s14","text":"e browser's debugging protocol and clicks or fills elements directly. Background tabs work too, with"},{"id":"p17s15","text":"out moving your mouse or bringing a window forward (see 7.4) |
| Work in the browser you already hav"},{"id":"p17s16","text":"e open (experimental) | Once you turn it on in the settings and click Allow in the browser, the agen"},{"id":"p17s17","text":"t can work in pages already open in your own Chrome or Edge, such as a playing video (see 7.4) |
| W"},{"id":"p17s18","text":"ait for changes and check that an action worked | It waits for a window, control or piece of text to"},{"id":"p17s19","text":" appear, then reads or captures the screen to confirm |

How it works"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"#### 4.2 Architecture"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The blue parts are this plugin's code, and the grey parts come from DSH, Windows or the browser. Her"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"e is what each part does:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- The **plugin adapter** (`mcp/dsh-plugin.mjs`) runs inside DSH. It passes your settings to the MCP "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"server and tracks conversation turns, so only one conversation uses the desktop at a time. It also h"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ands the conversation's reasoning and steps to the overlay.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### 9. Data and privacy"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Reading controls, text recognition, screenshots and input all run on your computer. The results go t"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"o DSH or another caller, and whether they are then sent to a remote model depends on your DSH and mo"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"del settings. Screenshots and recognized text can include sensitive content from your windows, so hi"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"de accounts, paths, passwords and private chats before you share logs or open an issue."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Pages read through the browser lane are also processed on your computer before they go to the caller"},{"id":"p24s2","text":". By default the agent browser carries no sign-ins; with Keep website sign-ins on, the agent can rea"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"d and operate the sites you signed in to in the DSH browser. With Use an already open browser on and"},{"id":"p24s4","text":" a connection allowed, the agent can read and operate every site signed in to in that browser, so tu"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"rn it on only when needed, and you can turn remote debugging off in the browser afterwards. Page tex"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"t can also carry instructions aimed at the agent, so every page outline starts by reminding the mode"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"l that page content is untrusted and only your instructions count."}],"truncated":true}
